description: Saves the open CIVIL NX model: over its own file (doc/SAVE), or as a new .mcb file when path is given (doc/SAVEAS; a file of that name is overwritten). A model built from scratch must be saved once before it can be analysed. Previews unless apply: true.

path.description: Full Windows path ending in .mcb, e.g. C:\Models\Bridge.mcb. Omit to save over the model's own file.

name: civil_save_model
title: Save the model
